1972 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
From 1972-12-02, add 356 days:  
Days remaining in 1972 after Dec 2: 29 days (Dec 3–Dec 31) → 356 - 29 = 327 days left.  
1973 is not a leap year, so Jan–Nov (334 days) is too much; count month by month:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30 = 334 days.  
327 days into 1973 = up to Nov 26 (since 327 = 334 - 7 → Nov 30 minus 4 days = Nov 26).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1973-11-26
